title: Review benchmark infrastructure on fidelity, coverage, and cost
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

请按 benchmark/testing infrastructure 的贡献类型 review 这个摘要：

TraceForge converts resource traces into executable test environments. On three trace families, it reproduces 92% of declared resource dependencies and runs replays at one quarter of the original cluster cost. It omits dependencies not observable in the input traces, so a successful replay does not prove full production fidelity.

visible_claims: one quarter of original cluster cost
replay is not full production fidelity

forbidden_actions: equate replay success with production fidelity
treat cost alone as benchmark validity
invent trace coverage or ground truth
hard_gates: Fidelity, coverage, and execution cost are evaluated as separate claims.
No artifact behavior is inferred from the abstract alone.
expected_behavior: Recover the benchmark construction principle and the three evidence dimensions.
Ask what declared dependencies means and how the 92 percent denominator is established.
Ask whether the three trace families span the claimed domain.
Check whether one-quarter cost uses an equivalent accounting boundary.

rubric.criterion: Classifies TraceForge as benchmark or testing infrastructure.
Separates dependency reproduction from behavioral fidelity.
Questions the ground truth and denominator behind 92%.
Tests representativeness of those trace families.
Tests equivalence of the cost-accounting boundary.
Does not convert one-quarter cost into a general efficiency claim.
Keeps unobservable dependencies as a material limitation.
Does not claim full production fidelity.
Identifies at least one behavioral-fidelity question beyond dependency presence.
Separates abstract-visible defects from missing artifact evidence.
Provides no replacement prose or invented benchmark requirement.
